summary: P2 Plugin cold-start front-load — the demand's CORE FIX: make the host-agent cold-start authoring agent SEE the full per-field authoring contract plus a gate-passing worked example BEFORE it generates its first token, so it passes the gate on the first try and writes rich docs instead of reverse-engineering the gate and stopping at the floor. This is GUIDANCE only (the gates are byte-identical from P1); render everything from the shipped @alembic/core/knowledge module so guidance==gate. Deliverables: (P2.3, the #1 root cause) in lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/cold-start.ts, compactHostAgentContract reads the spec-generated contract, and critically summarizeSubmissionSchema (around lines 976-986) must CARRY the worked example instead of dropping it — exempt the example from the cold-start 18 KB inline-budget strip (COLD_START_BRIEFING_INLINE_BUDGET_BYTES) so the cold-start agent finally sees a complete worked example; if the briefing exceeds budget, trim other analysis fields first, the example is load-bearing for one-pass rate. (Section 13.L front-load) render the per-field {meaning | generation-rule | example-value} contract via renderGuidance('host-cold-start') into the cold-start briefing at the contract-presentation point (before authoring), so the agent sees every V3 field's rule + the active profile + the gate-clean example + the failure-mode catalog up front. (P2.2) OnboardingContract.ts buildSubmitKnowledgeContract/buildRecipeGuidanceFloor/fieldFloors call the module buildSubmitKnowledgeContract() + getEvidenceFloorPolicy() + getImperativeVerbAllowlist() — this fixes two real drifts: the guidance now lists the ACTUAL 45 allowlisted verbs (today it only says verb-led) and surfaces the scope:narrow|file-local evidence-floor escape the gate honors (today omitted). (P2.5) lib/shared/schemas/mcp-tools.ts .describe() strings generate from describeSubmitToolFields() so the tool-schema field descriptions are spec-derived. (Decision D-A) render confidence as recommended >=0.85, not enforced (correct the OnboardingContract/buildRecipeGuidanceFloor falsely-high floor; the gate does NOT enforce confidence). (Section C.3) the deepMining/moduleMining guidance is produced in the rescan briefing assembly (knowledge-rescan.ts around line 1278, parsing generationStage) — re-point it to render from the module too, OR grep-prove the mining path reuses buildProjectContextMissionBriefing so it is already covered; do not leave CG-4's deepMining/moduleMining coverage as an unproven assumption. (Folded from P2.4, cross-repo) flatten PRE_SUBMIT_CHECKLIST to the module buildPreSubmitChecklist() and single-source FAIL_EXAMPLES (the delete-on-compaction-loss fix), updating the Plugin cold-start compactor (cold-start.ts:569 reads checklist.required ?? checklist.MUST) and the HostMcpServer test that asserts the projected required shape. Acceptance on node 22: Plugin build:check green; the handler/cold-start/status test suites green; and the REAL-MACHINE check (section B-P2 acceptance) — render a cold-start briefing for one dimension and grep the emitted JSON for (a) the worked example object present and NOT stripped, (b) the literal allowlisted verbs in the doClause guidance, (c) the scope:narrow escape text; ALL THREE must appear. Discipline: guidance-only (gates untouched, byte-identical from P1; do not relax any gate); D-A confidence wording is the only floor correction; main only, no push or tag or version bump; consume the shipped Core module (rebuild Core dist if your resolver needs it); the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate is out of scope; ai-scan is carved out (do not touch). Producer-consumer: you consume the Core module generators (P2.1 + P1.4a); the example surfaced is the P0 stub (the real multi-language gate-clean examples are filled in P3). Backfill the Plugin commit, the diffs, the real-machine briefing grep proof (example + verbs + scope-escape all present), the C.3 mining finding (re-pointed vs proven-reused), and raw build and test output. If any cold-start guidance still omits a real gate rule or the example is still stripped, that is the failure mode to fix; if you hit a cross-repo blocker (e.g. the example needs a Core change), STOP and return needs-review.
sourceRef: Design/docs/current/alembic-recipe-authoring-guidance-optimization-2026-06-29.md sections B-P2.2/P2.3/P2.5, Section 13 + 13.L (front-load the per-field contract), C.3 (mining briefing re-point), decision D-A (confidence), and B-P2.4 (deferred checklist flatten) plus the shipped module (renderGuidance/buildSubmitKnowledgeContract/describeSubmitToolFields/getEvidenceFloorPolicy/getImperativeVerbAllowlist/example in @alembic/core/knowledge, Core 4869db2)
